title: Uncertain-begin boot-recovery test bets a real 250 ms bind budget on scheduling, so a loaded full gate fails its session_bind
outcome: tests::engram_uncertain_begin::a_begin_answered_for_another_grant_records_the_evaluated_grant_until_recovery_confirms_it_clean (and its sibling boot-recovery cases in engram_uncertain_begin.rs that recover through RecordingBootRecoveryTransport) no longer fail when a worker is scheduled late. Today the boot-recovery bind runs under the fixture's deadline_ms Some(250) (enable_test_project_engram) on the Real EngramBudgetClock: binding_deadline = clock.now() + call_timeout at engram_host_adapter.rs:6415-6416, checked by rpc_timeout_until at :6496, so a stall over 250 ms between the session status and the bind transmission fails the target with "Engram operation budget exhausted before transport" and the test sees [session_status] instead of [session_status, session_bind]. Occurrence: full gate test-70965744-f34e-418d-a1e4-33255862db9c (w-8cd40956f686, .tmp/wt-fixture-tmp-9474, base 593c783), target elapsed 527 ms. Production budgets and defaults stay unchanged.
acceptance: A controlled delayed-worker diagnostic, without machine load, first fails the unchanged test's [session_status, session_bind] assertion by holding the worker past 250 real ms between the session status and the bind transmission. The original failed gate run is retained.

One state-owned clock boundary is the only reader of the state's EngramBudgetClock. AppState::engram_budget_clock and both target constructors (engram_host_adapter.rs:5837, :5932) snapshot through it. The fixture selects the clock before enabled settings are published and before any target or worker snapshot. Re-enabling preserves an explicitly selected Real or the same Scripted instance. Production stays Real, with every budget value unchanged.

The uncertain-begin family runs on the shared scripted clock through the fixture path it uses. With the 300 ms real stall retained, the diagnosed test sees [session_status, session_bind]. A note lists each converted test's time sources and assertions. Budget expiry stays covered by tests that either advance the same clock across the causal boundary or declare Real.
A test shows that a failure on a recovery worker thread fails the owning test, not only stderr.
No production timeout, default or expiry semantics change, no retry is added, and the global undeclared-Real rejection is not in this slice.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

completion.summary: Slice 1 landed as train 24: the state-owned Engram budget clock boundary, with the uncertain-begin and boot-recovery target tests on a shared scripted clock, a Real-declared expiry witness, and test-only re-raise of boot-recovery worker panics. The branch commit 2972c0d was merged onto beb2e68 as landing commit 98ff008, under Opus2's integration gate test-296f295c and integration pair Codex cb799a67 / Claude f166f5f1. Acceptance evaluation a0feca20 passed 6/6. Its child B1 has since landed in d6b9442; B1b, B2-B5 and FINAL remain optional children.
